paragraphs: In Beitzah 5b he and Rav Shalman of Bei Kelochit both say, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The actual Davidson Beitzah 5b paragraph explicitly names Rav Ada and Rav Shalman and says that both are of Bei Kelochit. The source’s joint-speech direction and two full Rav titles are retained; no additional legal material or identity claim is imported.
